description: Paid (price: see tabularium_menu). Use to remember something beyond this session: decisions, state, results, notes, or a hand-off for another agent paying from the same wallet. Stores a UTF-8 value (up to 64KB; JSON as a string) under a key in the wallet's workspace. Every write is hash-chained and the head is signed, so what was stored, and when, can be proven later. The first write opens a 30-day workspace. Retries never write twice. Not for secrets unless encrypted first: the operator can read stored values.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Reuse the same id when retrying the same write yourself; one is generated if omitted

name: tabularium_write
title: Write a value
